$comment: Ceilings for the published WASM web bundle, enforced by scripts/check-wasm-size.js.
Measured on the tranche-50 dependency diet (agent-spreadsheet 0.14.0) and set at
the measured size plus 10 percent. These are meant to ratchet down: raising one
requires a reason in the commit message.
wasm-opt trades transfer size for compile size: at -Oz raw drops 16 percent but
brotli grows about 6 percent (unoptimized: raw 10239646, brotli 1936120).
